historicalCrossCheck: Q78 static audit independently recorded the same missing principal/tenant contract on the MCP path.
observations: AgentSession exposes session/project/parent fields, not a trusted authenticated principal.
McpClient tools/call sends name and model-provided arguments; _meta contains idempotency and correlation only.
AgentToolRunner dispatch resolves server/tool and safety annotations/ledger, then invokes callTool; no resource-scoped tenant authorization is checked in this path.
The server may independently authorize; that behavior is outside this client path and remains unverified.
decision: Do not fabricate a tenant principal or cross-tenant denial fixture. P2.1 remains blocked until a trusted host/server identity and resource authorization contract is defined and propagated.
